name: Sparse Edge Extraction
definition: Extracts the adjacency graph of a voxel set. Returns sorted unique nodes and an edge list (E, 2) of index pairs into the node list. It walks positive packed-key deltas to find neighbors, ensuring each undirected edge is found exactly once.
summary: Sparse Edge Extraction builds voxel adjacency graphs using sorted-array membership checks instead of KD-trees, offering superior efficiency for sparse data.
